title: Visual Information-Guided Parallel Decoding for Diffusion Multimodal Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.26580v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Diffusion multimodal large language models (dMLLMs) have recently emerged as a new decoding paradigm for multimodal generation. Starting from a fully masked sequence, dMLLMs progressively decode the sequence by unmasking a subset of the remaining masked positions at each step. Since the selected tokens serve as the prediction context for subsequent steps, deciding which tokens to decode is crucial to the quality of the final output. The most common strategy prioritizes tokens based on a certainty measure that tends to favor tokens frequently observed in the training data. translated_title: 视觉信息引导的扩散多模态大语言模型并行解码方法
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26580v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：扩散多模态大语言模型（dMLLMs）最近作为一种新的多模态生成解码范式出现。从一个完全掩码的序列开始，dMLLMs通过逐步解掩码剩余掩码位置的一个子集来逐步解码序列。由于选定的标记作为后续步骤的预测上下文，决定解码哪些标记对最终输出的质量至关重要。最常见的策略基于确定性度量优先选择标记，这种度量倾向于训练数据中频繁出现的标记。最近的方法根据标记对后续预测的影响进行排序，但没有显式考虑输入图像。我们提出了视觉信息引导采样器（VIG-Sampler），它基于标记对图像标记的注意力来优先选择标记。我们进一步施加了一个约束，惩罚那些图像注意力分布异常的候选标记。
tldr: 提出一种视觉信息引导采样器，通过利用标记对图像标记的注意力优先级和约束惩罚，改进了扩散多模态大语言模型的解码质量。
en_tdlr: We propose a visual information-guided sampler that prioritizes tokens based on their attention to image tokens and applies a constraint to penalize anomalous candidates, improving decoding quality for diffusion multimodal LLMs.
